title: Prospective validation of membranous NECTIN-4 expression and molecular characterization as predictive biomarkers for response to perioperative therapy with enfortumab vedotin and pembrolizumab in patients with urothelial carcinoma
summary: This is a non-interventional observational study for patients with urothelial carcinoma (bladder cancer) receiving enfortumab vedotin and pembrolizumab therapy before and after surgery. The study investigates whether specific tumor characteristics (NECTIN-4 levels) can predict the response to this therapy.

interventions.name: Patients with locally advanced or muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma (≥T2 or cN+) with indication for perioperative enfortumab vedotin + pembrolizumab therapy.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Locally advanced or muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma of the bladder (≥T2 or cN+)
Indication for perioperative EV+PEM therapy
Availability of tumor tissue for examination
Ability to provide informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
Missing informed consent
Missing tissue material
